edges.reason: msg.sender becomes the contract owner during construction.
msg.sender is stored as the ETH fee recipient wallet.
block.timestamp is used as the router swap deadline, making execution miner-dependent.
block.timestamp is used as the liquidity deadline, making execution miner-dependent.
_taxFee flows into the tax computation of _tokenTransfer.
_maxTxAmount bounds the transfer amount checked in _transfer.
bots blacklist mapping is read to reject transfers in _transfer.
_isExcludedFromFee decides whether tax applies in _transfer.
_balance mapping is read and written by the token transfer math.
_transfer delegates the actual balance mutation to _tokenTransfer.
transfer passes msg.sender and amount into _transfer.
transferFrom passes sender, recipient and amount into _transfer.
approve forwards spender and amount to _approve.
transferFrom decrements the allowance through _approve.
swapForTax passes the contract balance into swapTokensForEth.
collectTax passes the contract ETH balance into sendETHToFee.
burn moves the computed amount through _tokenTransfer with zero tax.
The from parameter determines the balance debited in _tokenTransfer.
The amount parameter drives the tax and transfer arithmetic.
The from parameter gates the swap/blacklist branch in _transfer.
The to parameter gates the fee and blacklist branches in _transfer.
_transfer performs an external token swap before updating any balances.
_transfer sends ETH out before completing its own state updates.
swapTokensForEth triggers the external router swap call.
sendETHToFee transfers native ETH to an arbitrary wallet.
_tokenTransfer executes the tax, subtraction and balance arithmetic.
burn executes division and multiplication to derive the burn amount.
addToWhitelist mutates fee exemptions with no owner restriction.
removeFromWhitelist mutates fee exemptions with no owner restriction.
lowerTax changes tokenomics with no owner restriction.
removeBuyLimit disables the transaction cap with no owner restriction.
blockBots writes the blacklist with no owner restriction.
unblockBot writes the blacklist with no owner restriction.
swapForTax lets anyone force a contract swap with no owner restriction.
collectTax lets anyone drain contract ETH to the tax wallet with no restriction.
Constructor assigns the owner state variable.
Constructor assigns the tax wallet state variable.
createUniswapPair reads the router to build the factory pair.
addLiquidity calls the uniswap router to add ETH liquidity.
The external router swap can re-enter _transfer while balances are still stale.
An attacker-controlled router can re-enter the unrestricted swapForTax function.
The tax wallet ETH transfer can re-enter the unrestricted collectTax function.

normalization_plan.reason: The _transfer from parameter only exists to feed the core transfer logic.
The _transfer to parameter only exists to feed the core transfer logic.
The _transfer amount parameter is consumed by the token transfer arithmetic.
The transferFrom sender parameter is forwarded to _transfer.
The transferFrom recipient parameter is used when crediting balances.
The spender parameter is only used when writing the allowance.
The newTaxRate parameter only feeds the lowerTax state change.
The buyer parameter only feeds whitelist state changes.
The bots_ array parameter only feeds the blacklist loop.
contractTokenBalance is only the swap input for swapTokensForEth.
contractETHBalance is only used to decide whether to forward ETH fees.
burnAmount is a transient value computed inside burn.
tTeam exists only as an intermediate tax arithmetic value.
tTransferAmount exists only as an intermediate arithmetic value.
path is the swap route consumed by the external router call.
